bracket: [Textbook misprint: the question reads "X-axis and line x = -4 are parallel lines". The line x = -4 is parallel to the Y-AXIS and perpendicular to the X-axis, so as printed the question has no answer - the two lines meet. The printed key of 4 is the distance from the Y-axis, which is what the question means to ask, and the answer below is given on that reading. Read "X-axis" as "Y-axis".]
